# Dr Furella Aesthetics

> Dr Furella Aesthetics is a doctor-run cosmetic, body contour and skin clinic with locations in Parramatta (Sydney) and Maitland, NSW. Led by Medical Director Dr Furyal Moughal, the clinic offers doctor-led consultations, chemical peels, HIFU skin tightening, laser hair removal, laser pigmentation and vascular treatments, skin needling with Platelet Derived Therapy and exosomes, skin treatments, intravenous therapy consultations and a range of medical aesthetic procedures, alongside accredited training for doctors, nurses and dentists.

- Type: doctor-run cosmetic, body contour and skin clinic
- Phone: 0432 122 959
- Email: info@drfurellaaesthetics.com.au

## Locations
- Parramatta (Sydney): 146 Pennant Street, Parramatta NSW 2151
- Maitland (Hunter Valley): 15 Bourke Street, Maitland NSW 2320

## Services
- [Facial Concerns Consultation](https://drfurellaaesthetics.com.au/facial-concerns-consultation/): A consultation with a registered practitioner to discuss facial concerns such as lines, volume and balance.
- [Skin Quality Consultation](https://drfurellaaesthetics.com.au/skin-quality-consultation/): A consultation with a registered practitioner about skin firmness, texture and hydration. Suitability and any treatment are assessed individually.
- [Chemical Peels](https://drfurellaaesthetics.com.au/chemical-peels/): A consultation is required to determine whether a chemical peel may be appropriate for your skin.
- [Laser Hair Removal](https://drfurellaaesthetics.com.au/laser-hair-removal/): Hair reduction over a course of sessions. Suitability is assessed at consultation.
- [Laser Pigmentation & Vascular](https://drfurellaaesthetics.com.au/pigmentation-vascular/): A consultation is required to identify the concern and determine whether laser treatment may be appropriate.
- [Cosmetic Teeth Whitening](https://drfurellaaesthetics.com.au/pearly-white-cosmetic-teeth-whitening/): A cosmetic whitening treatment. Suitability is assessed before treatment.
- [Skin Needling](https://drfurellaaesthetics.com.au/skin-needling/): Collagen-induction microneedling. A consultation is required to determine whether it may be appropriate for you.
- [Skin Treatments](https://drfurellaaesthetics.com.au/skin-treatments/): Hydrodermabrasion, LED, oxygen facials and collagen masks. Suitability is assessed before treatment.
